item.title: Hubble 1.1.10
item.description:
Hubble 1.1.10
Hubble 1.1.10: Clearer controls and DIT Browse workspace actions
- Refresh HubDash with readable text, neutral backgrounds, flatter buttons, matching dropdowns, and a blue Update button. - Let Variables and Advanced Actions use the available workbook height and stay open independently while resizing. - Add DIT Browse Switch workspace and Cycle workspaces actions. Cycle advances through the available workspaces and wraps back to the first. - Keep workspace switching compatible with older DIT Browse connections and report when an update is needed.
